q.en: Improve the sentence: 'She is more taller than her sister.'
q.as: বাক্যটো উন্নত কৰা: 'She is more taller than her sister.'

explanation.en: 'Taller' is already comparative, so 'more' is redundant. Use 'She is taller than her sister.'
explanation.as: 'Taller' ইতিমধ্যে তুলনামূলক, সেয়ে 'more' বাহুল্য। 'She is taller than her sister.' শুদ্ধ।
